answer_1.quote: We annotated a new native dataset on the text generated by 2 strong multilingual LLMs in 3 languages for the multilingual FActScore task.
datasets: new native dataset in Spanish, Arabic, and Bengali

answer_2.quote: FActScore was introduced to estimate the factuality of generated texts automatically

answer_3.quote: Factuality Scoring is a binary classification task. It employs an evaluator V assigning a binary (supported/not supported) label

answer_4.quote: We hired 2 native annotators for each language and followed the same annotation guidelines by to evaluate the true FActScore of generated text.
answer_4.guideline: evaluate the true FActScore by labeling atomic facts as supported or not supported based on a knowledge source
